name: Moving Covariance Rate Barrier
lineage_evidence: DT fixed-teacher absolute covariance matching was beneficial only while its internal mismatch descended; the same operator later harmed its induced state
SEARCH-005:G1-DT-CNDRP and G2-DT-BCNRP changed the native gradient metric from instantaneous replicate sensitivity but did not use a moving temporal covariance reference
SEARCH-005:G2-HNEK-PHRSUP constrained a physical residual-rate defect, not directional covariance drift

prior_equivalence_audit.material_difference: MCRB never adds a covariance-matching loss, never scales the native gradient by a DT confidence score, never accepts or rejects an auxiliary correction, and never substitutes a teacher endpoint. It evaluates the current and a one-data-epoch EMA generator on the same current unpaired bridge state and common latent bundle only to form a moving directional-covariance gap. It then observes the exact bias-corrected Adam parameter displacement already produced by the native optimizer and, only when that actual displacement has positive first-order derivative of the moving gap, commits the unique closest Euclidean half-space projection. Adam moments remain the native moments. The moving reference follows the candidate itself and converges to it at a stable state; no plain output or frozen early value is a target.

unsb_object: the exact native Adam generator displacement measured against the temporal rate of the latent bridge-direction covariance field
formula: For current unpaired bridge state X_t, physical time t and a common M-latent bundle Z, let c_theta=vec(log(clamp_min(U_reg_norm(theta;X_t,t,Z),eps_machine))). Let theta_bar be the generator EMA with decay beta=2^(-1/N), where N=150 updates is exactly one frozen small25 data epoch. Define D_k(theta)=||c_theta-stopgrad(c_theta_bar)||_2^2/(2q) and a_k=grad_theta D_k at theta_k. First let native Adam update its moments and form its exact proposed parameter displacement d0. If <a_k,d0><=0 or ||a_k||=0, commit d0 exactly. Otherwise commit d*=d0-(<a_k,d0>/||a_k||_2^2)a_k, the unique argmin_d ||d-d0||_2 subject to <a_k,d><=0; the float32 implementation moves by an additional dtype-derived machine-epsilon margin solely to keep the represented displacement on the feasible side. Then update theta_bar <- beta theta_bar+(1-beta)theta_{k+1}. D/E/F, the native losses, endpoint forward, rollout construction and inference are unchanged.
identity_or_unbiased_condition: The operator is exact identity whenever the moving covariance gap has zero tangent or the exact native Adam displacement already makes its first-order change nonpositive. At a stable generator the EMA catches the current generator, so the gap and tangent self-null. A native fixed point with zero gradient and zero Adam moment remains fixed. The half-space projection is the minimum Euclidean alteration of an unsafe actual displacement and has no tunable strength.
target_inaccessibility_proof: MCRB reads only the current official unpaired training bridge state, its sampled physical time, isolated generator latents, current netG, its own recoverable EMA netG and native Adam state. Its RNG-isolated covariance observation restores all CPU/CUDA RNG. Discovery70, confirmation20, paired targets, PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, plain checkpoints and domain-level paired labels are not addressable by the model.

expected_applicable_state.condition: the native optimizer proposes a parameter displacement that locally increases the candidate's own moving latent direction-covariance gap
expected_applicable_state.self_null_state: the moving covariance tangent is zero or the native actual Adam displacement is already rate-safe
expected_applicable_state.evidence_scope: the construction is authorized by DT-specific temporal mismatch evidence; HJ supports the state-feedback failure class but does not authorize a universal controller

falsifying_experiment: Kill the implementation if disabled one-step identity, exact resume, EMA recovery, RNG isolation, minimum-displacement half-space feasibility, native Adam-moment preservation or current endpoint/inference identity fails. Close only this moving-covariance actual-displacement barrier if cross-state branches do not reduce positive target-blind covariance-gap directional derivatives or if its complete seed2026 e200 trajectory is negative.
compute_cost: M current-generator and M no-gradient EMA-generator endpoint calls plus one covariance-defect backward per native G update; native D/E/G/F optimizer counts and data exposure are unchanged
memory_cost: one EMA generator, M current endpoint graphs, M no-gradient EMA endpoints and one defect-gradient copy
recovery_state_cost: EMA generator, fixed half-life, update/intervention counters, last target-blind geometry and ordinary full RNG/optimizer/sampler state

ablation_definitions.proposal_only: When the moving covariance tangent is nonzero, replace the native G displacement by the norm-matched negative covariance-gap tangent without the native-safe half-space projection; this isolates the moving covariance proposal and is expected to expose target bias or overcontrol.
ablation_definitions.observable_only: Compute the common-random-number current/EMA covariance gap and exact native directional derivative, restore RNG, but commit the complete native Adam displacement unchanged.
ablation_definitions.projected_or_full: Commit native Adam exactly when safe; otherwise commit only its unique closest Euclidean displacement with nonpositive first-order moving-gap derivative, while retaining native Adam moments.
